title: Air Fryer Jacket Potatoes
description: Crisp salty skin and a fluffy centre, no oven preheat. Report back on the timing and I will formalise it.

confidence.note: General method, not yet confirmed. Report back on the timing and I will formalise it.

items.note: Sebago, russet or coliban, approx. 300g each

steps.text: Scrub the potatoes ({{potatoes}}) well and dry thoroughly. Prick each one 6–8 times all over with a fork so steam can escape.
Rub the skins with the olive oil ({{oil}}), then the salt flakes ({{salt}}). The salt draws moisture out of the skin, which is what makes it crisp rather than leathery.
Air fry at 200°C for 45–50 minutes, turning once halfway. Done when a skewer slides through the centre with no resistance. Smaller 200g potatoes need closer to 35 minutes.
Rest 3–4 minutes, then cut a cross in the top and squeeze the ends towards each other to push the flesh up and open.

Fork the butter ({{butter}}) through the flesh while still hot. Top with the cheese ({{cheese}}), spring onion ({{spring-onion}}) and pepper ({{pepper}}). Back in for 2 minutes if you want the cheese properly melted.

notes.title: Confidence
notes.text: General method rather than a tested card. The timings are calibrated to a 300g potato and will shift with your machine. Check with a skewer rather than trusting the clock.

notes.title: Potato variety
notes.text: Waxy potatoes (desiree, kipfler, chat) will not work. You need a floury, high-starch variety or the centre stays dense.

notes.title: No foil
notes.text: It traps steam and softens the skin.

notes.title: Oven
notes.text: 200°C fan, 60–75 minutes, same prep. Slightly better skin, much longer.

notes.title: Fillings that suit your pantry
notes.text: Bacon and sour cream; chorizo with smoked paprika; gochujang butter with spring onion; leftover shredded taco chicken with cheese.
